_comment: 'Subí tu orden' (/upload-order): the assistant that reads the uploaded referral and says which appointment to book and how to prepare. Includes the shared upload zone (wz-upload.js) and the shared preparation model (prep.mjs).
upload.ai_down.banner: The automatic referral reader is unavailable right now.
upload.ai_down.body: You can still book the appointment: choose the service, upload the referral in that step, and the hospital will review it. No need to wait.
upload.ai_down.cta: See services and book an appointment
upload.ai_down.meta_desc: The referral reader is unavailable right now. You can still book by uploading the referral.
upload.doc_dudoso.msg:
This looks like {tipo}, not a medical referral.
Want to find and upload the correct referral?
upload.error.bad_file_html:
We couldn't open the file.
Try a photo (JPG) or a PDF of the referral.
upload.error.cant_read_file: We couldn't read the file. Try another photo.
upload.error.illegible_html:
We couldn't read what the referral says.
If you can, take another photo with more light and no shadows. You can still continue: the referral is saved and the hospital will review it.
upload.error.rate_limited: You've made several requests in a row. Wait a bit and try again.
upload.error.service_html:
We couldn't analyze the referral right now.
It's not your photo: the automatic reader is unavailable. Try again in a bit, or book the appointment and bring the referral to the center.
upload.error.too_big_html:
The file is too large to upload.
If it's a multi-page PDF, upload just the referral page, or take a photo instead.
upload.error.turnstile: We couldn't verify you're a person. Upload the referral again.
upload.links.search: Search for the test or specialty
upload.page.meta_desc: Upload the referral your doctor gave you: we'll tell you which appointment to book and how to prepare.
upload.page.subtitle: We'll read it and tell you which appointment to book and how to prepare.

upload.prep.title_multi: How to prepare for your tests
